result.summary: The main visual issue is that the bottom navigation bar overlaps with the content area, causing the text and image of the bottom-most restaurant card (likely a pizza place) to be partially hidden and cut off at the bottom of the screen.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the last card in the 'Popular right now' section, obscuring content.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding or a bottom margin to the main container or list view to ensure that the final item is not hidden behind the navigation bar.
